prompt: Complete CharExploder.allChars so it returns every character of every word as its own one-character string, in order -- a classic flatMap job.
explanation: map turns each element into exactly one result, but here each word must expand into many characters, which is what flatMap is for: the function returns a Stream per element and flatMap splices them into one flat stream, preserving encounter order. word.chars() yields an IntStream of character codes, so mapToObj((char) code -> ...) converts each code into a one-character String. Empty words simply contribute empty streams and vanish from the output.
hints: Start with words.stream() and reach for flatMap, since one word becomes many output elements.
word.chars() gives an IntStream of character codes; use .mapToObj(...) to turn each code into a String.
Cast the int code to char and wrap it: String.valueOf((char) code); finish with collect(Collectors.toList()).
